# Answerability sort

`customer_support.df.self_service_deflection.answerability_sort` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Answerable / account-specific / adversarial — sort every intent into one before deciding whether it may be deflected at all.

Answerable intents deserve content. Account-specific ones need a human with the record in front of them. Adversarial ones — refunds, cancellations, disputes — are where self-service is read as evasion, and deflecting them damages the relationship even when the answer is correct.
